headline: China and Canada Sign Terms of Reference for Financial Working Group
summary: The People's Bank of China signed the China-Canada Financial Working Group Terms of Reference with Canada's Department of Finance and the Bank of Canada.
why: Bilateral financial working groups establish formal channels for regulatory dialogue, cross-border banking cooperation, and macroeconomic coordination between central banks.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Formalizes bilateral financial communication channels without enacting immediate macroeconomic policy changes.
